messages:
incident-bot: PAGER → High error rate and missing traces for tenant 'BlueHarbor' (tenant_id=th_0192) on dedicated pool ded-07 (us-west-2). 5xx spikes 18% over 5m, traces not arriving for tenant. Ops link: https://ops.internal/alerts/2098765432

meera_sre: ACK — picking up. I'm SRE on-call. Starting triage: checking forwarder and trace ingress for ded-07. @tanya_csm can you confirm BlueHarbor is on ded-07 and if they've done any deploys in last hour?

tanya_csm: confirmed, BlueHarbor on ded-07. No deploys from customer side in last 2h. Customer reported slow responses on their web app ~13:40 UTC.

alex_platform: I'm available to take if needed, oncall until 15:00 UTC. Initial hypothesis: per-tenant observability partitioning may have lost forwarder role binding — leads to logs/metrics ingest but traces dropped. I'll run forwarder health checks.

meera_sre: running:
```
kubectl -n obsv get pods -l app=forwarder-ded-07 -o wide
kubectl -n obsv logs deploy/forwarder-ded-07 -c forwarder --tail=200 | grep th_0192 | tail -n 50
```

meera_sre: logs show forwarder running, but TLS handshake errors with trace collector for tenant th_0192: "remote error: tls: bad certificate". Metrics look partial — some points are ingested but partition key for traces missing.

juan_eng: saw similar TLS rotation issue earlier this month — root cause was ephemeral token rotation failing when KMS key rotated. Can someone check service account tokens and KMS access for forwarder role?

alex_platform: checked IAM & KMS — service principal forwarder-ded-07 had its KMS decrypt role removed by an infra automation 13:35 UTC. Re-granting now.

alex_platform: re-applied role binding, restarting forwarder deployment.

oncall-bot: @alex_platform acknowledged the page and is the active mitigator.

meera_sre: after restart, trace batch ingestion resumes for tenant th_0192 — I can see new spans at 13:51 UTC. Replayed a 10m window to backfill missing spans via:
```
obsctl replay --tenant th_0192 --since 13:30 --to 13:50 --target ded-07
```
Backfill started, approx 80% of missing spans recovered. Metrics partition still had a short lag; rehydration job enqueued.

tanya_csm: notifying BlueHarbor (CSM FYI). I'll send a status note: short trace gap (~20m) during 13:30–13:50; mitigation applied; backfill in progress.

meera_sre: elevated to Sev2 (customer-facing degrad). Continuous monitoring for 30m. I'll keep thread open until backfill and p95 latency return to baseline.

alex_platform: added short-term guardrail so forwarder rebind step will auto-alert if role changes again. Filed infra ticket INF-4021.

meera_sre: final check 14:10 UTC — p95 back to normal, traces flowing, backfill ~95% complete. Leaving monitoring for 30m then will resolve if stable.

meera_sre: RESOLVED — traces verified and customer notified. Postmortem owner: alex_platform. Root cause: automated KMS role change removed decrypt permission for forwarder service principal causing trace TLS failures for tenant-specific trace channel. Action items: INF-4021 (auto-alert), runbook update (trace-ingress role sanity), customer follow-up template.

tanya_csm: BlueHarbor acknowledged and appreciative of quick fix :thumbsup:
